metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Automattic's Special Projects team for WordPress development, security, and client work

plugins.name: plugin-review
plugins.description: Security review a WordPress plugin by slug, URL, or current directory.

plugins.name: pr-feedback
plugins.description: Address unresolved PR review comments. Fetches open threads via GitHub GraphQL, evaluates validity, and applies fixes or surfaces questionable feedback for user decision.

plugins.name: studio-repo-clone
plugins.description: Back a local WordPress Studio site with a GitHub repo. Either scaffold a brand-new site whose wp-content is a fresh clone, or convert an existing site's wp-content into a clone while preserving uploads, SQLite database, and the SQLite drop-in.

plugins.name: wpbakery-to-gutenberg
plugins.description: Convert WPBakery (Visual Composer) pages on a local WordPress Studio site to Gutenberg block markup in place. Includes a single-page skill and a batch slash command that dispatches one subagent per page.

plugins.name: html-to-block-theme
plugins.description: Convert a set of static Claude Design HTML/CSS/JS files into a standards-driven WordPress block theme on a local Studio site, using theme.json, block styles, patterns, and build-less custom blocks, refined to match via Playwright.
